items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: the group that came into Great Lakes from St. Louis under the leadership of – the old fox, we used to call him – Len Bowden.

ctx.x: Let me scratch that. We were talking – I want to go over again some persons that were at Great Lakes and see if you have – we went through a few – but see if you have recollections of some of these others. Dave Young?

Dave Young was a saxophone player from Chicago, and as I mentioned earlier in our discussion, the group that came into Great Lakes from St. Louis under the leadership of – the old fox, we used to call him – Len Bowden.
